name: open-in-chat
title: Open in Chat
description: A small control that turns a prompt into links opening it in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Grok or v0. It can appear as an inline row of brand icons or as a dropdown under one trigger.
use: A docs or blog page wants readers to continue a question in a full AI chat instead of a short callout.
avoid: It only opens external sites with a query string; it does no streaming, history or answer rendering itself.
a11y: Keyboard and labels are solid; the menu's entrance animation has no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A card footer with a pale bar holding the label Ask AI and five tiny brand marks, plus an outlined Open in chat button with a chevron. The open menu is a dark rounded panel of five labelled rows, each with a brand glyph and a small external-link arrow.
behaves: Clicking the trigger drops the list of assistants; choosing a row opens that service in a new tab with the prompt filled into its query. The inline version shows each site as an icon, and hovering one shows a tooltip naming it.
customise: Pass the prompt and pick the dropdown or horizontal layout; override the trigger label and alignment, or render custom OpenInChatLink children to change the destinations.
weight: light: A trigger with a Radix menu of five links and no fetching or animation loop.
